name: sprite_builder_set_env
description: Set (create or update) a project environment variable injected into the deployed container at `docker run`. Key must be letters/digits/underscores, not starting with a digit. Set vars BEFORE the build you want them in; values are redacted from logs.

project_id.description: The project's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_list_projects / sprite_builder_create_project).

key.description: Env var name (letters, digits, underscores; not starting with a digit).
